notes: Registered in docs/research/score-components-v1.md and bound by entry-signal-family-rules-v1.md. v2 resolves an ambiguity found before any relationship was computed: five components record both a raw `value` and a discretised 0-2 `points`, and this study reads `value`. The ingredient is the measurement; points is the composite's own discretisation and HYP-019 already found the composite ranks backwards. minimum_completed_trades counts EPISODES, one per pump event, not decision rows. The margins are read as ABSOLUTE spreads between the top and bottom quintile, because a component predicting the outcome downwards is as informative as one predicting it upwards. A candidate also requires monotonicity across all five quintiles. Sufficiency is checked before either verdict.
